lesson:
2026-09-28 retrospective claim-scope clarification, not a new measurement: Retain the historical software timing result and zero leakage under model-input perturbation. This experiment establishes conditional model causality only: its saved instrument perturbs synthetic model inputs, not audio through the feature builder. It does not establish whole deployed-pipeline future-audio independence or measured real-fixture latency. The later exp-009 is a separate, version-bounded example: that tested pipeline had upstream feature leakage and its repair still exempted five oracle beat-grid channels. Upstream source/version equivalence between the two historical runs is not established here; do not treat this cross-link as a new refutation of the exact earlier full path. Preserve historical gates and verdict; no rerun.

2026-09-28 additional retrospective instrument-scope clarification, not a new measurement: Retain the reported 62.5 ms calculation versus the 65 ms target and the separately measured component timings, but the available evidence does not establish the full learned audio-in-to-DMX-out p99. In execution-unpinned candidate source 1656ffde47a26bbd9655b5ceef8ddaebd80e4895, the timed synthetic trunk/A/B forward excludes audio-feature compute, C sampling and descriptor processing; the budget combines model p99 with amortized conductor/packing medians and assumed network/fixture costs, while the candidate conductor/packing percentiles repeat single clip-amortized measurements 100 times. Stagewise timing is allowed by the original Plan, but complete stage coverage and defensible composition or overlap bounds are missing; a p99-plus-medians sum is not generally total p99, no latency overrun is measured, and the available future-input probe observes A only rather than all heads or full audio/DMX, so preserve historical numbers, Notes, gates and verdict while retaining both original full-software-latency qualification and future-AUDIO qualification as unestablished without substituting a current-version test.
